name: Shoot
description: Shoot the selected enemy. Costs no energy. Shots can miss; critical hits deal extra damage.

name: Stun shot
description: Damage the selected enemy, interrupt its current attack, and stop it from moving or attacking for 3 seconds.

name: Heal
description: Restore health to yourself and other living players within 22 m. No target needed.

name: Shield
description: Give yourself a shield that absorbs damage for up to 6 seconds. Nearby enemies turn to attack you. No target needed.

name: Power shot
description: Fire a powerful shot at the selected enemy. Deals 35% extra damage if the enemy is stunned, then ends the stun. Combo bonuses increase this extra damage.

name: Area blast
description: Blast the selected enemy and visible enemies within 12 m of it. Weakened enemies take an extra 20% damage, increased by combo bonuses, then stop being weakened.

name: Ghostline
description: Move at least 12 m over at least 2 seconds, then use this ability. A blue ghost repeats up to 6 seconds of your movement. After 0.6 seconds, touch it to blast enemies within 10 m, regain 20 energy, and make your dash ready. If another player touches it first, the blast has 50% more power and both of you get the refill. No target needed.

name: Weaken
description: Damage the selected enemy and weaken it for 8 seconds. It takes 20% more damage while weakened. Area blast uses this bonus, then ends the effect.

name: Drain health
description: Damage the selected enemy and heal yourself for 40% of the damage dealt. More damage means more healing.

name: Finishing shot
description: Shoot the selected enemy. Deals 60% extra damage if it has 30% health or less. Combo bonuses increase this extra damage.

name: Weaken area
description: Damage the selected enemy and visible enemies within 10 m of it. Weaken them for 8 seconds so they take 20% more damage. Area blast uses this bonus, then ends the effect.
